mission.title: Between Waking and Sleeping
mission.description: Track the Cypherites from their local base of operations.

npc.say: Good luck with that data! I know it's been keeping the boss up late at night.

phase.briefing:
Greetings, {player}. Although we have known for some time that Cryptos is the leader of the Cypherite organization, the Zion Council is concerned that our understanding of his group's operations remains hazy at best. Although for the moment he seems content with following his program of harassing bluepill recruitment efforts, and making appearances around the city at his "boxes," we are unable to predict his next move. Clearly, we need to gather more intelligence on Cypherite activities.
One of our spies managed to follow a group of Cypherites from one of Cryptos' boxes to what appears to be their local base of operations. We want you to investigate the area and track their activities. Be careful; they will most likely be hostile if encountered.

enter.say: That's where our spy traced the Cypherites to. I'm not picking up any redpill activity inside.

done.say: Rifling through Cypherite underwear drawers, what fun! Find anything good? I'm dying to know what kind of jammies they wear.
A business card, eh? "Somnus Consulting Services." Interesting. Head outside while I look up their address.

phase.briefing: City records are surprisingly blank on the history "Somnus Consulting Services." All we know is that they have a current business license, membership in a prominent ethical business practices group, and a good tax record.

enter.say: I've got some signals in there. Looks like bluepills.
Oops! Looks like you just got on the receptionist's bad side.
Hey! You can't go in there! I'm calling security!

talk.say: Hey, what's up? Let me know if I can help you with anything while you're here.

objective.text: Get the key from Sammie Nyhart

talk.say: Oh, you're here for the boss' data? Right. You'll need this key to get into his safe. Gosh, it's a good thing you asked; he didn't tell me to expect anyone today.

done.say: That key might come in handy.
Data source reading is getting stronger. Somewhere in that room...

objective.text: Get the disk from the boss' safe

done.say: Ah, that's where the reading was coming from. Grab that disk!
Upload that baby to me at a hardline.

objective.text: Upload the disk at a hardline

phase.briefing:
The data you recovered contains references to what appears to be a project for "forced reinsertion" of redpills into the Machine system. This is quite worrisome, Warrior. If the Cypherites were to get such a capability...I don't like to think what could happen.
The data also contained coordinates to a rendezvous point. I'm sending you to that location now. Treat any Cypherites you find there as highly dangerous.

enter.say: I've got redpill signals in there. Have we found our Cypherites?

done.say: That one was carrying something. Search them.

objective.text: Get the address from the Cypherite Gunslinger

done.say: Another address. How deep does this little group go? We'll have to check it out once you've finished off those Cypherites.
That's the last of the Cypherites in the area.

phase.briefing: Stay on their trail, {player}. It is vital that we get to the bottom of this Cypherite plot.

enter.say: Weird... I've got a few redpill signals in there, but very weak.
Whoa. Dead Cypherites--and not long dead, either. Looks like someone else beat us there.
Another Cypherite...but who's the other woman? She isn't wearing their usual mask.
Hey, a live one! And would you check out the get-up that guy's in. Hm... His RSI signal is weak. You'd better see if you can give him a hand.

done.say: Looks like we've got a fanatic Neo martyr on our hands. But a guy like that couldn't have taken out all those Cypherites on his own. I'm not picking up anything else of interest in the area. We'd better report this to Tyndall.

mission.finish: A fatally wounded young man, dressed like Neo, surrounded by dead Cypherites? I'm not sure what to make of that, Warrior. I'll have to run a search through our intel database for any matching reports. Unfortunately, his overzealous interference has destroyed our only lead into what could be a very dangerous Cypherite plot.
